note: Sinopia's checks: affrescoui test index.scenarios.json. The presenter's clock reads the wall clock, so its frames are checked by their nodes and state, not by pictures.

scenarios.name: sinopia-load-the-sample
scenarios.note: The sample deck loads: seven slides in two sections, the first picked, its thumbnails listed

scenarios.name: sinopia-pick-a-slide
scenarios.note: A thumbnail click picks its slide; the arrows move through the list from there

scenarios.name: sinopia-add-a-shape
scenarios.note: A shape from the gallery lands in the middle of the slide, selected, and undo takes it away

scenarios.name: sinopia-add-a-text-box
scenarios.note: Insert, Text Box: a text object saying Text, selected

scenarios.name: sinopia-format-fill-and-line
scenarios.note: The format pane paints the selected shape's fill and line from the theme and thickens the line

scenarios.name: sinopia-format-size-and-rotation
scenarios.note: The format pane's steppers size, place and turn the selected shape

scenarios.name: sinopia-delete-and-undo
scenarios.note: Delete removes the selected shape and its build; undo brings both back, redo removes them again

scenarios.name: sinopia-duplicate-an-object
scenarios.note: Ctrl+D copies the selection a little down and right and selects the copy; copy and paste do too

scenarios.name: sinopia-arrange-order
scenarios.note: Arrange's menu moves the selected shape in the drawing order: to the front, one back, to the back, one forward

scenarios.name: sinopia-shape-effects
scenarios.note: Shape Effects gives the selected shape a shadow or a glow, like the format pane's Effects; each one undoes

scenarios.name: sinopia-align-and-distribute
scenarios.note: One shape aligns to the slide, several to the box around them; distribute leaves equal gaps; the arrow keys nudge

scenarios.name: sinopia-lock-an-object
scenarios.note: A locked shape survives Delete and keeps its place; unlocked, it goes

scenarios.name: sinopia-add-an-animation
scenarios.note: Motion gives the selected subtitle a fade on a click, then starts it with the previous and lengthens it

expect.text: 1 on this slide, 1 on a click

scenarios.name: sinopia-new-duplicate-delete-slide
scenarios.note: New Slide adds one after the current, a duplicate copies it with new ids, Delete removes it

steps.note: The rail scrolls to the slides further down

scenarios.name: sinopia-slide-transition
scenarios.note: Transitions sets the slide's kind, its duration and direction, and applies it to every slide

scenarios.name: sinopia-hide-a-slide
scenarios.note: Hide Slide leaves a slide out of the show and veils its thumbnail; again brings it back

scenarios.name: sinopia-speaker-notes
scenarios.note: The notes under the slide are the slide's: typed into, hidden and shown

steps.note: The rail scrolls to the slides further down

scenarios.name: sinopia-outline-view
scenarios.note: Outline View lists the slides' text in place of the thumbnails; a click picks a slide

expect.text:
Harbour Lights
A winter festival on the waterfront
Planning review · Spring

scenarios.name: sinopia-sorter-view
scenarios.note: Slide Sorter shows every slide in a grid; a click picks one, Enter opens it

scenarios.name: sinopia-sorter-drag-to-reorder
scenarios.note: In the sorter a slide dragged onto another moves there

scenarios.name: sinopia-dark-mode
scenarios.note: Dark Mode turns the window dark and leaves the slides as they are

scenarios.name: sinopia-export-pdf
scenarios.note: File, PDF writes a page for every slide in the show (the hidden one left out)

scenarios.name: sinopia-save-and-open
scenarios.note: The deck saves as JSON and opens again, as an undoable change; a file that isn't a deck is refused

scenarios.name: sinopia-present-and-step
scenarios.note: The show starts from the first slide; a click or an arrow plays the slide's builds, then the next slide

scenarios.name: sinopia-present-skips-and-blacks
scenarios.note: The show skips a hidden slide; B and W blank the screen black or white and back

steps.note: The rail scrolls to the slides further down

scenarios.name: sinopia-present-ends-at-the-end
scenarios.note: End jumps to the last slide built; one more step ends the show on the last slide

scenarios.name: sinopia-presenting-keys-off-when-editing
scenarios.note: With the show off, its keys don't play: the arrows and B leave the deck alone

scenarios.name: sinopia-presenter-view
scenarios.note: With Presenter View on, the show opens in a window of its own and this one shows the notes, the next slide and a timer; See All Slides jumps to any slide

expect.text: Welcome everyone. Two minutes on why we are doing this, then the plan.

scenarios.name: sinopia-present-from-current
scenarios.note: Start and the status bar's button present from the slide being edited

scenarios.name: sinopia-the-sorter
scenarios.note: The sample deck in the sorter, every slide in a grid in place of the canvas (the gallery's scene, tools/media/gallery.json)

scenarios.name: sinopia-paste-menu
scenarios.note: The paste and copy arrows open their menus: Keep Text Only pastes plain text boxes, Duplicate copies the selection in place

expect.is:
Light trail
    Twelve installations along the quay
    Lantern boats on Friday
Food market in the warehouses

scenarios.name: sinopia-font-size-and-case
scenarios.note: The font and size fields open their lists; Change Case opens its five cases

scenarios.name: sinopia-colour-grids
scenarios.note: The colour arrows open a grid of theme, standard and highlight colours; the button itself gives the last colour picked

scenarios.name: sinopia-bullets-numbering-and-levels
scenarios.note: Bullets and numbering pick their marks from their menus; the list level buttons move every line four spaces

scenarios.name: sinopia-paragraph-menus
scenarios.note: Line spacing, columns, text direction and the vertical alignment each open a menu

scenarios.name: sinopia-select-menu
scenarios.note: Select picks every object, the text boxes, the shapes or nothing

scenarios.name: sinopia-section-menu
scenarios.note: Section adds, renames and removes the section the current slide is in

scenarios.name: sinopia-copy-style
scenarios.note: Copy Style keeps the selected object's look and gives it to the next object selected

scenarios.name: sinopia-find-and-replace
scenarios.note: Find goes to the next object holding the text, on any slide; Replace All changes it everywhere at once, and undo takes it back

scenarios.name: sinopia-slide-menus
scenarios.note: The New Slide arrow and Layout list the layouts

scenarios.name: sinopia-insert-tab
scenarios.note: Insert drops shapes, icons, styled text and symbols on the slide, turns on the footer and slide numbers, and its other buttons say they aren't available yet

expect.is: Inserting a table isn't available yet

scenarios.name: sinopia-edit-text-in-place
scenarios.note: A double click or F2 edits a text box's or shape's text on the slide; Escape or a click elsewhere ends it, and one Undo takes the whole edit back

steps.note: a frame, so the editor is built

scenarios.name: sinopia-context-menus
scenarios.note: A right click opens the slide menu on the rail, the shape menu on a shape and the slide's own menu on the canvas; Shift+F10 opens them from the keyboard

scenarios.name: sinopia-background-and-reading-view
scenarios.note: Format Background opens the pane for the slide; Reading View plays the show in the window, and Escape ends it

expect.is: Changing the slide size isn't available yet

scenarios.name: sinopia-launchers-and-gallery
scenarios.note: A group's launcher opens the format pane; a gallery's last arrow lists all its items (the shapes, the eight themes)

scenarios.name: sinopia-ink
scenarios.note: The Ink tab: a pen stroke and a highlighter stroke become ink objects (the highlighter's behind the text), the eraser takes the stroke under it, Clear Ink the rest, and Escape goes back to selecting

scenarios.name: sinopia-rehearse-timings
scenarios.note: Record > Rehearse Timings keeps how long each slide is shown; the show then moves on by itself; Clear Timings forgets them

scenarios.name: sinopia-check-and-comments
scenarios.note: Check > Accessibility lists a new slide's empty placeholders and goes to one; comments are added, written, resolved, found from another slide and deleted; Help shows the shortcuts

click.name: Delete All Comments in This Deck

scenarios.name: sinopia-sections-and-ribbon
scenarios.note: A section's title in the slide list folds its slides away (it then says how many) and back; Ctrl+F1 and the bar's button hide the ribbon, and a tab shows it again

scenarios.name: sinopia-align-text
scenarios.note: The paragraph buttons and Ctrl+L, E, R, J align the selected text box's text

scenarios.name: sinopia-present-go-to-number
scenarios.note: While presenting, a slide's number and Enter go to it (a number past the end goes to the last slide)

scenarios.name: sinopia-selection-pane
scenarios.note: The Selection Pane names the slide's objects, front first: a click selects one, the eye hides it (undo shows it again), and Show All and Hide All do every one

scenarios.name: sinopia-link-to-a-slide
scenarios.note: Insert > Link links the selected text to a slide of the deck: a click on it in the show goes there, a click elsewhere moves on, and Remove Link takes it off

click.name: Slide 5: Two ways to run it

scenarios.name: sinopia-preview
scenarios.note: Preview plays the slide in the window: its transition from the slide before, each build once the one before has played, then editing again on the same slide

scenarios.name: sinopia-animation-pane
scenarios.note: The Animation Pane lists the slide's builds in their order: a click selects one's object, the arrows reorder them (undoable), the cross takes one off

scenarios.name: sinopia-theme-colors-and-fonts
scenarios.note: Design > Colors gives the deck another theme's colours, and Fonts the titles' and the text's fonts; each is undoable, and a theme chosen after puts the colours back

scenarios.name: sinopia-search-commands
scenarios.note: The title bar's search (Alt+Q) lists the commands whose names hold what is typed, and Enter shows them: one runs on a click; the last item finds the text in the slides
